existing_quotes: V222_FOREX_QUOTES_V1 accepted OnTick callbacks; broker_ms is BOClockTick estimated time, not independent server millisecond timestamp. Existing clock observer throttles accepted rows to one per broker second. Do not equate clock-row count with quote-row count.

new_capture.quote_timestamp: q.time broker seconds, PC UTC/local seconds and monotonic arrival counter kept separately; no fabricated broker milliseconds
new_capture.completeness: Callback sequence and END footer validate local file integrity, not broker-wide tick completeness. MT4 callback coalescing, network/server gaps and PC clock accuracy remain limitations.
new_capture.heartbeat: Separate file, never a quote or interpolated tick
new_capture.bars: Closed M5 history with observation timestamps; not tick-derived bars or proof of predecision availability at historical times
new_capture.closed_orders: Export existing closed EURUSD market orders only, preserve broker timestamps, lots, profit/commission/swap and currency. No new trade or live account action.
new_capture.runtime_safety: No native headers, model/EA-state or operating folder writes; no AutoTrading requirement or change; separate third chart

bo: Provide actual-platform quote/payout/trade schemas with timezone-explicit ISO timestamps and source references. No MT4 Bid as platform price, no fabricated transactions; empty templates mean unavailable.
validation: Check schema, sequences, positive finite BidAsk, nonnegative spread, monotonic callback arrival, broker/PC time regressions, footer counts, metadata and observed commission units. Do not infer real-account fees from demo or a zero-row export.
decision: No economic backtest or deployment claims from the existing limited sample or the act of collecting data. Prior v1/v2/v3 economic protocols remain unchanged.
